tiers.text: Interview first, decide as a group, then write. What does an error bar on a binned point mean to the person reading the plot?

Two classic arguments: is the error the uncertainty of the weighted mean, or the scatter of the points? And what happens to a point sitting exactly on the last edge? Also think about empty bins, bad inputs and what gets returned.

Make sure SPEC.md has at least six numbered decisions, each stating a clear rule. Cover: bin edge convention including the last edge, out-of-range points, weights, mean and error, x position, empty bins, invalid input and output types. Leave src/ and tests/ alone.
